# Server Rules
## Rule 1: Community Conduct
- Treat all members with respect and courtesy. Toxicity, harassment, and impersonation of others are explicitly forbidden, along with bigoted content and offensive language.
- Harassment and personal attacks, especially such as defamation or doxxing will be met with removal from our community.
- Metacommunications (talking about the game, outside the game) is strictly against the rules.
## Rule 2: Roleplay
- Erotic Roleplay (ERP) is prohibited. No one should be engaging in sexual acts, or behavior, in-game, nor be leaving the platform to do it elsewhere. This applies to any literature or media in-game.
- Characters must be appropriate, and fit the setting through names, common sense (do not actively seek out pain or death) outside of proper roleplay circumstances, should not be needlessly suicidal, should seek comfort and care (should not be emotionally attached to your voidsuit). Generally, make efforts to eat quality food, engage with the people around them, and be an actual person.
- Roleplay cannot be used an excuse to needlessly murder or grief. Your character must have reason to attack or kill another individual personally.
- You must escalate when attacking another individual, making your intent clear (such as aiming your weapon at them, or ordering them to halt in pursuit) and giving them a chance to respond (them unholstering their weapon, or them continuing to flee). Special circumstances may warrant reduced escalation, such as political assassinations. Request permission from staff prior to obtain this.
- Netspeak is prohibited outside of proper context, such as electronic messaging or non-verbal capabilities.
- Use of metaknowledge that your character would not have access to is forbidden.
